analysis: The sampled-softmax change did not improve validation HR@10: the host reported macro HR@10=0.4088, versus the supplied prior result of 0.410 and original baseline of 0.505. Category HR@10 was 0.460 for Movies_and_TV, 0.415 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.315 for Electronics, and 0.445 for CDs_and_Vinyl. The 0.0012 macro decline offers no evidence that replacing detached hard-weighted pairwise loss resolves the regression; its statistical significance is unknown. The remaining gap cannot be attributed to a specific architecture or training choice from this experiment. Execution succeeded and consumed 909.0001 allocated GPU-seconds. These are validation results; no test results were available.
code_summary: Trains one independent HistoryModel per category and loads one selected checkpoint for each dataset route. Each network uses separate input/output item embeddings, positional embeddings, two causal Transformer blocks (128 dimensions, four heads), and jointly learned two-head attention pooling with recency decay. Last-position, mean, and pooled representations feed an MLP with a residual mean connection and LayerNorm. Scores use normalized context/output embeddings, a learned bounded scale, and jointly trained item biases. Training samples prefixes and 64 uniform negatives, masks negatives matching the target or visible history, and applies sampled-softmax cross-entropy. AdamW, gradient clipping, validation-based learning-rate decay, and early stopping select a single best checkpoint per category. Training seed remains 42; the predictor writer reconstructs the same architecture without averaging or auxiliary fitted scorers.
